list.name: agent_id
list.label: Agent
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT ServiceName FROM otel_traces WHERE SpanName = 'agent.session' ORDER BY ServiceName

list.name: session_id
list.label: Session
list.query: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(SpanAttributes['claude_code.session.id'],''), NULLIF(SpanAttributes['routeiq.session.id'],'')) AS session_id FROM otel_traces WHERE SpanName = 'agent.session' AND ServiceName = '${agent_id}' GROUP BY session_id HAVING session_id != '' ORDER BY max(Timestamp) DESC LIMIT 100

targets.rawSql: SELECT Duration / 1000000 AS duration_ms FROM otel_traces WHERE SpanName = 'agent.session' AND (SpanAttributes['routeiq.session.id'] = '${session_id}' OR SpanAttributes['claude_code.session.id'] = '${session_id}')

SELECT toInt32OrZero(SpanAttributes['routeiq.session.token_total']) AS total_tokens FROM otel_traces WHERE SpanName = 'agent.session' AND (SpanAttributes['routeiq.session.id'] = '${session_id}' OR SpanAttributes['claude_code.session.id'] = '${session_id}')

SELECT sum(toFloat64OrZero(SpanAttributes['routeiq.cost.usd'])) AS total_cost FROM otel_traces WHERE SpanName = 'llm.call' AND (SpanAttributes['routeiq.session.id'] = '${session_id}' OR SpanAttributes['claude_code.session.id'] = '${session_id}')

SELECT greatest(0, 100 - if(countIf(SpanName='tool.call' AND (SpanAttributes['routeiq.tool.success']='false' OR SpanAttributes['claude_code.tool.success']='false')) / nullIf(countIf(SpanName='tool.call'),0) > 0.1, 15, 0) - if(max(toInt32OrZero(SpanAttributes['routeiq.tool.retry_count'])) > 5, 10, 0) - if(countIf(SpanName='tool.call' AND (SpanAttributes['routeiq.loop.detected']='true' OR SpanAttributes['claude_code.tool.loop_detected']='true')) > 0, 25, 0) - if(countIf(SpanName='guardrail.check' AND SpanAttributes['routeiq.guardrail.triggered']='true') > 0, 20, 0) - if(max(if(SpanName='agent.session', Duration/1000000, 0)) > 30000, 30, 0)) AS score FROM otel_traces WHERE (SpanAttributes['routeiq.session.id'] = '${session_id}' OR SpanAttributes['claude_code.session.id'] = '${session_id}')

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(SpanAttributes['claude_code.session.task_success'],''), SpanAttributes['routeiq.task.success']) AS task_success FROM otel_traces WHERE SpanName = 'agent.session' AND (SpanAttributes['routeiq.session.id'] = '${session_id}' OR SpanAttributes['claude_code.session.id'] = '${session_id}')

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(SpanAttributes['claude_code.session.completion_reason'],''), SpanAttributes['routeiq.completion.reason']) AS reason FROM otel_traces WHERE SpanName = 'agent.session' AND (SpanAttributes['routeiq.session.id'] = '${session_id}' OR SpanAttributes['claude_code.session.id'] = '${session_id}')

SELECT SpanAttributes['routeiq.user.id'] AS user_id FROM otel_traces WHERE SpanName = 'agent.session' AND (SpanAttributes['routeiq.session.id'] = '${session_id}' OR SpanAttributes['claude_code.session.id'] = '${session_id}')

panels.title: Span Timeline
panels.description: All spans for this session in chronological order.

targets.rawSql: SELECT Timestamp AS time, SpanName AS span, if(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.tool.name'] != '', SpanAttributes['gen_ai.tool.name'], SpanAttributes['gen_ai.request.model']) AS tool_or_model, COALESCE(NULLIF(SpanAttributes['claude_code.tool.success'],''), SpanAttributes['routeiq.tool.success']) AS success, round(Duration / 1000000, 2) AS latency_ms, SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens'] AS input_tokens, SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens'] AS output_tokens, SpanAttributes['routeiq.cost.usd'] AS cost_usd, COALESCE(NULLIF(SpanAttributes['claude_code.tool.loop_detected'],''), SpanAttributes['routeiq.loop.detected']) AS loop_detected, SpanAttributes['routeiq.tool.retry_count'] AS retry_count, SpanAttributes['routeiq.guardrail.type'] AS guardrail_type, SpanAttributes['routeiq.replan.reason'] AS replan_reason FROM otel_traces WHERE (SpanAttributes['routeiq.session.id'] = '${session_id}' OR SpanAttributes['claude_code.session.id'] = '${session_id}') ORDER BY Timestamp ASC

panels.title: Penalty Breakdown
panels.description: Which reliability penalties applied and why for this session.

targets.rawSql: SELECT penalty, signal, value, deduction FROM (SELECT 1 AS ord, 'Tool failure rate >10%' AS penalty, 'tool_failure_rate' AS signal, toString(round(countIf(SpanName='tool.call' AND (SpanAttributes['routeiq.tool.success']='false' OR SpanAttributes['claude_code.tool.success']='false')) / nullIf(countIf(SpanName='tool.call'),0), 3)) AS value, if(countIf(SpanName='tool.call' AND (SpanAttributes['routeiq.tool.success']='false' OR SpanAttributes['claude_code.tool.success']='false')) / nullIf(countIf(SpanName='tool.call'),0) > 0.1, -15, 0) AS deduction FROM otel_traces WHERE (SpanAttributes['routeiq.session.id'] = '${session_id}' OR SpanAttributes['claude_code.session.id'] = '${session_id}') UNION ALL SELECT 2, 'Retry storm (max retry >5)', 'max_retry_count', toString(max(toInt32OrZero(SpanAttributes['routeiq.tool.retry_count']))), if(max(toInt32OrZero(SpanAttributes['routeiq.tool.retry_count'])) > 5, -10, 0) FROM otel_traces WHERE (SpanAttributes['routeiq.session.id'] = '${session_id}' OR SpanAttributes['claude_code.session.id'] = '${session_id}') UNION ALL SELECT 3, 'Loop detected', 'loop_count', toString(countIf(SpanName='tool.call' AND (SpanAttributes['routeiq.loop.detected']='true' OR SpanAttributes['claude_code.tool.loop_detected']='true'))), if(countIf(SpanName='tool.call' AND (SpanAttributes['routeiq.loop.detected']='true' OR SpanAttributes['claude_code.tool.loop_detected']='true')) > 0, -25, 0) FROM otel_traces WHERE (SpanAttributes['routeiq.session.id'] = '${session_id}' OR SpanAttributes['claude_code.session.id'] = '${session_id}') UNION ALL SELECT 4, 'Guardrail triggered', 'guardrail_count', toString(countIf(SpanName='guardrail.check' AND SpanAttributes['routeiq.guardrail.triggered']='true')), if(countIf(SpanName='guardrail.check' AND SpanAttributes['routeiq.guardrail.triggered']='true') > 0, -20, 0) FROM otel_traces WHERE (SpanAttributes['routeiq.session.id'] = '${session_id}' OR SpanAttributes['claude_code.session.id'] = '${session_id}') UNION ALL SELECT 5, 'Session timeout (>30s)', 'duration_ms', toString(round(max(if(SpanName='agent.session', Duration/1000000, 0)),0)), if(max(if(SpanName='agent.session', Duration/1000000, 0)) > 30000, -30, 0) FROM otel_traces WHERE (SpanAttributes['routeiq.session.id'] = '${session_id}' OR SpanAttributes['claude_code.session.id'] = '${session_id}')) ORDER BY ord
